changes.how: Remove the import of @/lib/work-text (line 8). Add a required prop `words` to ReadinessList with this type, exported from the file as ReadinessWords: `{ readyToIssue: string; toFix: <the type of screens.en.ts workReadiness.toFix>; fix: string; check: string; open: Record<string, string>; problems: Record<string, string | undefined> | null }` (take the member types with `import type { ScreensMessages } from "@/lib/admin-messages/screens.en"` and index them; a type import adds no code). `problems` is the record of templates by problem code, or null for English. In the component replace `tw.readyToIssue` by `words.readyToIssue`, `rw.toFix`, `rw.fix`, `rw.check` and `rw.open[...]` by the same members of `words`, and replace `readinessText(problem)` by a local function with readinessText()'s exact rule: when words.problems is null, or has no template for problem.code, show problem.message; else the template with each `{name}` replaced by problem.values?.[name] (leave the placeholder when the value is missing). The file keeps no "use client" line and imports no catalogue.

Move the markup of InvoiceTotalsView here from src/components/admin/work/invoice-totals.tsx as `export function InvoiceTotalsParts(props)`, with the same props plus a required `words: WorkMessages["invoiceTotals"]` (`import type { WorkMessages } from "@/lib/admin-messages/work.en"`), and the file-private VatRow helper it uses. Inside, `tw` is `props.words`. Imports: formatMoney, the types InvoiceTotals and VatNoteKey, VAT_NOTE_LABELS and vatGroupLabel from @/lib/work-invoice-ui (that module imports no catalogue: confirmed). No import of work-text. No "use client" line.

Keep InvoiceTotalsView for the server only: it becomes `export function InvoiceTotalsView(props: Omit<Parameters<typeof InvoiceTotalsParts>[0], "words">) { return <InvoiceTotalsParts {...props} words={workText().invoiceTotals} />; }`, importing InvoiceTotalsParts from ./invoice-totals-view and workText from @/lib/work-text. src/components/admin/work/invoice-issued.tsx (a server component, line 18) goes on importing InvoiceTotalsView from here unchanged. Update the doc comment: the server draws this one; the editor (a client part) draws InvoiceTotalsParts with the words it was handed.

A "use client" file. Line 44: import InvoiceTotalsParts from "./invoice-totals-view" instead of InvoiceTotalsView from "./invoice-totals". Add to DraftEditorProps (line 62) a required prop `readinessWords: Omit<ReadinessWords, "readyToIssue">` (import the type from ./invoice-readiness). Near line 655 draw `<InvoiceTotalsParts … words={useAdminText("work").invoiceTotals} />` (read the words once at the top of the component: `const work = useAdminText("work");`; the Work layout already hands the work area to its client parts). Near line 676 draw `<ReadinessList … words={{ readyToIssue: work.invoiceReadiness.readyToIssue, ...props.readinessWords }} />`. Pass `readinessWords={props.readinessWords}` on to <IssueDialog> near line 684.

A client part. Add the required prop `readinessWords: Omit<ReadinessWords, "readyToIssue">` to IssueDialogProps, and at line 126 draw `<ReadinessList … words={{ readyToIssue: useAdminText("work").invoiceReadiness.readyToIssue, ...props.readinessWords }} />` (read the words at the top of the component, not inside JSX, to keep the hook rule).

Where it draws <DraftEditor …> (near line 140) add the prop `readinessWords`. Build it on the server from the request's language: `const rw = workScreens().workReadiness;` (import workScreens from @/lib/work-text; the page already sets the Work language through workWords()), and pass `{ toFix: rw.toFix, fix: rw.fix, check: rw.check, open: rw.open, problems: <null when the account's admin language is English, else rw.problems> }`. Take the language the way the page already knows it (the value workWords() returns or sets; if only work-text knows it, add a small exported `workLang()` to src/lib/work-text.ts that returns current().lang).

The test draws the draft editor with renderToString: pass the new required prop `readinessWords` built from the English catalogue (`import { screensEn } from "@/lib/admin-messages/screens.en"`: `{ toFix: screensEn.workReadiness.toFix, fix: …fix, check: …check, open: …open, problems: null }`). No expectation changes.

commits.title: The AI manager's chat labels a tool and names the page without the tool definitions and the admin map

changes.how: No imports. Move the TOOL_WORDS record here verbatim with its doc comment from src/lib/manager-tools.ts (it starts at line 318, `export const TOOL_WORDS: Record<string, string> = {`, and ends at its closing `};`, near line 621).

Replace the moved record by `export { TOOL_WORDS } from "./tool-words";` (about 30 test files import TOOL_WORDS from ./manager-tools and keep working). If this file itself reads TOOL_WORDS, also import it.
No imports. Move here from src/lib/saved-skills.ts the three constants `SKILL_TITLE_MAX = 120`, `SKILL_WHEN_MAX = 300`, `SKILL_STEPS_MAX = 2000` (lines 10-12).
Replace the three constants by `export { SKILL_STEPS_MAX, SKILL_TITLE_MAX, SKILL_WHEN_MAX } from "./skill-limits";` plus an import of the ones the file uses.

Line 7: take the three constants from "@/lib/skill-limits" and keep the types as `import type { RemoveSkill, SaveSkill, SkillDraft } from "@/lib/saved-skills";`. Line 13 (`export type { SaveSkill, SkillDraft } from "@/lib/saved-skills";`) is a type export and stays.

Add a server action `export async function pageHereAction(storeSlug: string, pathname: string): Promise<string | null>`. First statement: `const member = await requireOwner(storeSlug);` (the same guard its neighbours use). Then: refuse a pathname that is not a string of at most 300 characters starting with "/admin" (return null). Load the map inside the action: `const [{ matchPath }, { PAGES_NB }, { adminLangOf }] = await Promise.all([import("@/lib/admin-map"), import("@/lib/admin-messages/pages.nb"), import("@/lib/admin-lang")]);`. Apply the rule now at src/components/admin/ai-manager.tsx lines 391-393 exactly: `const here = matchPath(pathname); const page = here && here.page.id !== "assistant" && (here.page.area === "store" || here.page.area === "account") ? here.page : null; if (!page) return null;` then return the title: for a Norwegian account (adminLangOf(member.account.adminLocale) === "nb") `PAGES_NB[`${page.area}:${page.id}`]?.title ?? page.title`, else `page.title`. It reads no store data and writes nothing. Doc comment: 'The name of the admin page the owner is on, for the chat's first suggestion: the admin map stays on the server (bloat review step 0.11).'

The platform's twin: `export async function pagePlatformHereAction(pathname: string): Promise<string | null>` with `const p = await principal();` first (the guard its neighbours use), the same body with area "platform" in place of "store" in the rule, and the language from the platform admin's account (the same expression this file or its layout uses for the admin language; if `principal()` does not carry the locale, use `await actionAdminLang()` from the module its neighbours import it from).

(1) Remove the imports of matchPath from @/lib/admin-map (line 9) and PAGES_NB from @/lib/admin-messages/pages.nb (line 13). (2) Line 11: import TOOL_WORDS from "@/lib/tool-words". (3) Add to the type AiManagerActions an optional member `pageHere?: (pathname: string) => Promise<string | null>;` with the comment 'The name of the page the owner is on, from the server; none where it is not bound.' (4) Replace the three lines near 391-393 (`const here = matchPath(pathname); const onPage = …; const starters = […]`): keep a state `const [pageName, setPageName] = useState<string | null>(null);` and an effect on `[pathname, actions.pageHere, <the flag that says the conversation is empty and the suggestions are shown>]` that, only while the suggestions are shown and actions.pageHere exists, sets the name to null, calls `actions.pageHere(pathname)` and sets the answer if the effect was not cleaned up meanwhile (a `let live = true; return () => { live = false; };` guard). Then `const starters = [...(pageName ? [fillWords(w.helpHere, { page: pageName.toLowerCase() })] : []), ...w.starters[area]];`. Until the answer arrives the usual suggestions show without the page's. Place the hooks with the component's other hooks, above any early return.
In the `actions={{ … }}` object given to <AiManagerLauncher> (near lines 121-128) add `pageHere: pageHereAction.bind(null, store.slug),` and add pageHereAction to the import from ./assistant/actions.
In its actions object (near lines 44-51) add `pageHere: pageHereAction.bind(null, slug),` and import it.
In its actions object (near lines 90-97) add `pageHere: pagePlatformHereAction,` and import it from ./assistant/actions.
In its actions object (near lines 43-50) add `pageHere: pagePlatformHereAction,` and import it.

In the existing test, change the request listener to collect the Response of each script request made after the press (page.on("response", …) filtered by request().resourceType() === "script", storing the promise of `(await response.body()).length`), await them after the panel is visible, and add: `expect(total, "the chat's scripts on first opening").toBeLessThanOrEqual(130_000);` (raw bytes, as the first-scripts budgets count them). Add a second test: with the panel open on /admin/{store}/products, the first suggested question names the page (the Products page's title, lower case, inside the text of the suggestion that fills w.helpHere), and after pressing the rail's Orders link with the panel still open the first suggestion names Orders. Print the measured total with console.log so the commit can record it.

Under the AI manager's rule add: 'A new tool has a line in `TOOL_WORDS`, which lives in `src/lib/tool-words.ts` (re-exported by `manager-tools.ts`). The chat (`ai-manager.tsx`, a client part) imports neither `manager-tools`, `owner-tools`, `admin-map` nor a `pages.*` catalogue: it asks the server for the page's name through the `pageHere` action. `e2e/signed-in/ai-manager-panel.spec.ts` holds the scripts fetched on first opening to 130,000 bytes (bloat review step 0.11).'

Near lines 153-160 the file records the chat's 0.48 MB chunk: add the date and the new measured size, that the budget lives in the panel's spec, and the Work invoice route's bytes before (4,274,839) and after.

do_not: Do not import @/lib/work-text, @/lib/admin-text or an admin-words module from a "use client" file or from a file a client part imports.
Do not change any word in TOOL_WORDS, any tool's name, description or schema, or any prompt: no eval run or recording is part of this step.
Do not put the admin map or the Norwegian page list back in the browser as a smaller copy; the server names the page.
Do not let pageHereAction run before its permission check, read store data, or accept a path that does not start with /admin.
Do not remove the re-exports from manager-tools.ts and saved-skills.ts: tests import from there.
Do not make `pageHere` required in AiManagerActions (the launcher and the page are bound in four places; a missed one must still type-check and draw).
stop_if: ReadinessList or InvoiceTotalsView has a caller this brief does not name (rg -n 'ReadinessList|InvoiceTotalsView|InvoiceTotalsParts' src/components/admin/work src/app): report it.
After the build a first-load chunk is still 600,000 bytes or more: report which route lists it and one sentence it holds.
More than 26 routes are over 1,300,000 bytes: list them (node -e over .next/diagnostics/route-bundle-stats.json) and report; do not cut further on your own.
The chat's scripts on opening are above 130,000 bytes: report the three largest script URLs and their sizes.
The agents' eval replay test (agent-eval-replay.int.test.ts) fails: a prompt or tool text changed; undo and find it.
The first suggestion flickers or names the wrong page after a navigation in the hand check.
executor_why: Both changes are specified to the prop and the import, and a unit test, the panel's byte budget and the build's largest-chunk figure hold them, but one adds a server action behind a permission guard and the other changes props across client and server parts, so a stronger model should read the diff.
checked_in_code: I read invoice-readiness.tsx and invoice-totals.tsx (neither has "use client"; both import src/lib/work-text.ts, which imports the whole registry, and both are drawn by the client parts invoice-draft-editor.tsx and invoice-issue-dialog.tsx; invoice-issued.tsx draws the totals on the server), the invoice page that draws DraftEditor, and src/lib/work-invoice-ui.ts (no catalogue import). I read ai-manager.tsx (imports matchPath at line 9, TOOL_WORDS from manager-tools at line 11, PAGES_NB at line 13; the map is used only for the first suggestion at lines 391-393), manager-tools.ts (imports zod and owner-tools at its top; TOOL_WORDS at line 318), ai-skills.tsx and saved-skills.ts (three limits beside an import of assistant-skills), and the four places the chat's actions are bound. Choice made: the findings offer two ways to name the page, slim generated lists in the browser (AI-4, about 125,000 bytes expected against the 130,000 line) or a server action (AC-8, BN-15, about 60,000). The brief takes the server action: it has room under the line and needs no generator script. Note for the order of steps: once step 0.7 is in, work-text.ts loads two areas instead of all 136 files, so the 1.7 MB chunk shrinks before this step; the props change is still what keeps a client part from importing a catalogue.
